sections.section_title: Clock dividers for dead-time generators and digital filters
sections.text_helper: Section 35.5.16 "Clock dividers for dead-time generators and digital filters" in chapter 35 (General purpose timers (TIM15/TIM16/TIM17)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 1377.
sections.section_content:
The dead-time generators and the digital filters (for tim_tix) are using a DTS_ck clock (with a
tDTS period), derived from the tim_ker_ck clock.
A prescaler can decrease the frequency to extend the deadtime period programmed with
the CKD[1:0] bitfield in the TIM_CR1 register. A second prescaler can decrease the
resulting DTS_ck clock to extend solely the digital filters range, with the CKD2[3:0] bitfield in
the TIM_CR1 register.
[Figure 508. Clock prescalers for dead-time and digital filters]
